selected.name: Dezső rész
selected.approximationNote: Actual forest tracks and watercourses close a broad rural map cell of about 0.706km² at this historical forest locality. The cell is a rough locality search area; the name association is inferred and not an official district border.

selected.name: Farkasgaz
selected.approximationNote: Actual rural track/watercourse cell around the Farkasgaz label and the independently named Farkasgaz tanya source farm. Includes the farm surroundings rather than only buildings; association with the whole cell is estimated.

selected.name: Homoktelep
selected.approximationNote: Actual local roads, tracks and drainage lines delimit the eastern settlement-edge cell at Homoktelep. A rough whole-locality search area including residential and adjoining garden land; not an official quarter boundary.

selected.name: Molnárkút
selected.approximationNote: Actual street/watercourse cell around Molnárkút utca on the western settlement edge. Estimated local area; the point labels the map cell rather than creating its outline.

selected.name: Vénkert
selected.approximationNote: Actual garden access roads and drainage lines enclose this Vénkert garden-area cell north of the village. A low-confidence local search area, potentially only part of the wider historical garden name.

selected.name: Hosszúgaz
selected.approximationNote: Unchanged whole source polygon explicitly named Hosszúgaz tanya. Associated with the nearby Hosszúgaz locality label; this is the farmstead parcel itself and is not a claim to all surrounding historical fields. It is a source map polygon, not a building union or radius.

selected.name: Szalmás
selected.approximationNote: Unchanged whole source polygon explicitly named Szalmás tanya, at the end of its named access road. Associated with the nearby Szalmás locality label. The mapped farmstead area is retained; wider agricultural extent is not established.

selected.name: Szőlőskertek
selected.approximationNote: Rough manual outline of the contiguous garden/access-road fabric north of Hosszúpályi, guided by actual garden tracks, field/forest transitions and the Tence channel. Includes the wider Szőlőskertek area and can overlap the smaller Vénkert locality. Outer northern/eastern garden transitions are estimated, not a printed named-quarter border.

selected.name: Csonkás
selected.approximationNote: Actual rural tracks and drainage enclose this cell at Csonkás, beside the separately named Csonkás tanya source farm. It includes the farm setting and surrounding plots, not only farm buildings; name-to-cell association is approximate.

selected.name: Gugyori
selected.approximationNote: Broad actual track/road/watercourse cell west of Monostorpályi around the Gugyori label, including the rural settlement setting and adjoining fields. It is an estimated locality area, not an official administrative quarter.

selected.name: Magyarkert
selected.approximationNote: Actual main/local road courses enclose the western Magyarkert village-edge area. The choice preserves a larger coherent local area rather than the small street block at the name point. Internal and village-level subdivisions may overlap.

selected.name: Tejfeles
selected.approximationNote: Actual rural track and drainage network closes this garden/field area north of the village at Tejfeles. Historical local literature describes vineyard cultivation in Tejfeles; the cell association is a rough inference, not the historical cadastral perimeter.

selected.name: Liliom
selected.approximationNote: Unchanged whole source farmstead parcel explicitly named Liliom tanya and containing the Liliom locality point. Preserves the entire mapped farm site; association of the short locality name is estimated and surrounding agricultural fields are not declared part of the source parcel.

selected.name: Dr. László Elek-lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Actual local street courses enclose the coherent estate area at its name point, including the internal Dr. László Elek lakótelep service streets. The municipal TAK independently lists the estate. This is a physical street-area estimate, not an official estate border.

selected.name: Hajnal utcai lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Actual local street cell around the Hajnal estate blocks. The municipal TAK explicitly identifies the Hajnal street area as an estate. A rough estate-core search area; not a claimed cadastral border.

selected.name: Tass utcai lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Actual street cell around Tass street estate blocks. The municipal TAK independently lists the Tass street estate. A rough estate-core area, not a surveyed complete estate perimeter.

selected.name: Üveggyári lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Actual local street courses enclose the estate strip beside the glassworks at its preserved name point. The municipal TAK lists the estate and municipal planning material distinguishes the former factory service housing. Estimated association; does not rename the factory parcel as housing.

selected.name: Üveggyár
selected.approximationNote: Unchanged actual industrial source polygon explicitly named Orosházi üveggyár. Associated with the Üveggyár locality point contained within it; the factory site itself is the mapped search area, distinct from the adjacent housing estate.

selected.name: Belváros
selected.approximationNote: Rough street-junction trace of the nine-street Belváros boundary explicitly published by the municipality for its community project. Actual OSM street courses/junctions guide the trace. Short connections where street names or OSM endpoints do not meet, especially Kígyó/Arany and Sámsoni/Móricz, are inferred; street curves are coarsened. This is not an exact authoritative digitization.

selected.name: Mátészalkai Ipari Park
selected.approximationNote: Unchanged southern component of the actual industrial landuse relation, containing the industrial-park label and MOM industrial site. This component is physically separate from the northern Nyugati Iparterület component; name association remains approximate.

selected.name: Nyugati Iparterület
selected.approximationNote: Unchanged northern component of the industrial landuse relation, containing the Nyugati Iparterület label. The spatially separate southern component receives the industrial-park name. These are inferred local names for real mapped industrial surfaces, not aliases of the whole multi-part parent.

selected.name: Ráckert lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Actual major road/rail cell at Ráckert, preserving a coherent broader estate area instead of a single small street block. The locality name is separately listed in local sources. An approximate physical search area; no official quarter boundary is claimed.

selected.name: Északi lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Rough manual outline of the northern residential street fabric west of the Széchenyi corridor, north of Jármi/Kalmár and around the Nyár/Északi körút estate streets. Northern/western residential transitions follow the mapped landuse edge at coarse precision. This represents the whole local street area rather than one block; name assignment is inferred.

selected.name: Keleti lakótelep
selected.approximationNote: Rough manual trace of the eastern residential street area around the Keleti lakótelep label, bounded by the Széchenyi corridor to the west and actual residential/field transitions to the north/east, stopping north of Fellegvár. Street and garden edges are generalized; this is an estimated broader estate search area, not a printed quarter border.

selected.name: Cinevég
selected.approximationNote: Rough manual outline of the Cinevég residential ribbon along Dózsa György/Vágóhíd/Artézi kút streets north of Kocsordi út, guided by the actual residential fringe and field/industrial transitions. The locality label is near the southern end of the ribbon. This estimated area preserves the broader locality rather than a field cell or point circle.

selected.name: Fogarassy-tanya
selected.approximationNote: Rough historical locality area east of the Széchenyi road around the Fogarassy-tanya label, including the present concrete-business plots and surrounding clearing between the mapped forest/field edges and the southern Fekesszegi access area. Agricultural-to-industrial reuse is visible in the source parcels. The extent and historical name association are inferred, not a claim that the businesses are current farmsteads.
